title: 1 Peter Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on 1 Peter 3: a gentle and quiet spirit, blessing instead of insult, and the eight souls saved in Noah's day.

questions.text: According to verses 1 and 2, how may a husband who does not obey the Word be won?
questions.explanation: Verses 1 and 2 say such husbands may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word, seeing their pure behavior in fear.

answers.text: By the words of his wife
By the behavior of his wife
By the teaching of the elders
By the fear of the king

questions.text: Which adornment does verse 4 call very precious in the sight of God?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 speaks of the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in the sight of God.

questions.text: Who is named in verse 6 as obeying her husband and calling him lord?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: so Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are.

questions.text: What reason does verse 7 give for husbands to give honor to their wives?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 tells husbands to live with their wives according to knowledge, giving honor to them, that their prayers may not be hindered.

answers.text: So that their houses may prosper
So that the nations may praise them
So that their prayers are not hindered
So that the elders may receive them

questions.text: What are they told to do in verse 9 instead of rendering insult for insult?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says: not rendering evil for evil, or insult for insult, but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this.

questions.text: What is the one who would love life told in verse 11 to seek and pursue?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says: let him turn away from evil and do good; let him seek peace and pursue it.

questions.text: On whom are the eyes of the Lord, according to the words quoted in verse 12?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 quotes: the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer, but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.

answers.text: On the kings of the earth

questions.text: What should they always be ready to do, according to verse 15?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says to be always ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear.

answers.text: Give an answer about their hope

questions.text: How many souls does verse 20 say were saved through water in the days of Noah?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says that in the ship few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

questions.text: Where is he who has gone into heaven, according to verse 22?
questions.explanation: Verse 22 says he is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, with angels and authorities and powers made subject to him.

answers.text: In the prison of the spirits
At the right hand of God
Among the authorities of the earth
